run_selective_ci: run the selective CI script to determine which test components to skip or test based on git diff
test_list_files_in_commit: test the list_files_in_commit function that enumerates all file paths in a git commit tree
test_check_patterns_are_valid: test the check_patterns_are_valid function that validates glob patterns match existing files
test_component_info: test the ComponentInfo dataclass that defines files, dependencies, and env vars for a CI component
run_selective_ci_base_commit: run the selective CI script with a custom base commit to compare against origin/main
